scenes.en: It may be more than growing up.
scenes.say: Your teen's glasses power keeps changing every few months? It could be more than just growing up.

scenes.en: The cornea, the eye's clear front window, can thin and bulge into a cone.
scenes.ta: கண்ணின் முன் பகுதி மெலிந்து கூம்பு போல் மாறலாம்
scenes.say: The cornea is the clear front window of the eye. In a condition called keratoconus, it slowly thins and bulges forward like a cone. Light then bends unevenly.
Sign one. The power keeps changing, especially the cylinder power.

scenes.en: Blurred, stretched or double vision, even with new glasses.
scenes.say: Sign two. Things look blurred, stretched or doubled, even with new glasses.

scenes.en: Glare and halos around lights, plus a strong eye-rubbing habit.
scenes.ta: விளக்குகளை சுற்றி ஒளிவட்டம்; அடிக்கடி கண் தேய்த்தல்
scenes.say: Sign three. Glare and halos around lights at night, often in teens who rub their eyes a lot.

scenes.en: It often starts in the teens. Found early, treatment can help slow it.
scenes.ta: பெரும்பாலும் டீன் வயதில் தொடங்கும்; ஆரம்பத்தில் கண்டால் கட்டுப்படுத்தலாம்
scenes.say: Did you know? It usually starts in the teens or early twenties. When it's found early, treatment can help slow it down.

scenes.en: Stop eye rubbing. Treat itchy allergies. See a specialist for a cornea scan.
scenes.ta: கண் தேய்ப்பதை நிறுத்துங்கள்; கண் மருத்துவரை பாருங்கள்
scenes.say: Help your teen stop rubbing their eyes, get itchy allergies treated, and see an eye specialist for a detailed scan of the cornea.
If the power keeps changing, don't just keep changing glasses. Book an eye test today.
